raw_response:
A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Veggies**:

**Ingredients:** 2 chicken breasts, 1 lb baby potatoes (halved), 1 broccoli crown (florets), 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 garlic cloves (minced), juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp oregano, salt/pepper.

**Method:** Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt, pepper; roast 425°F 15 min. Push aside, add chicken (pounded thin) and broccoli tossed with remaining oil, garlic, oregano, lemon juice. Roast 12–15 min until chicken hits 165°F. Done in ~30 min, one pan to wash.
